scope: 142 resources across compute, storage, network, and governance

findings.title: Memory capacity is fully allocated
findings.observation: 16 of 16 GB is allocated in the snapshot, leaving no measured headroom.
findings.impact: Workload bursts can trigger paging, latency, or process termination.
findings.action: Profile peak memory, then resize the instance or set a tested scaling policy.
findings.validation: Repeat the peak-load test and verify at least 20% memory headroom.

findings.title: Production resources have no declared backup policy
findings.observation: The inspected fixture contains no backup policy or retention declaration.
findings.impact: Recovery point and retention expectations cannot be verified before an incident.
findings.action: Declare backup coverage, retention, and restore-test ownership.
findings.validation: Run a restore test and retain the successful recovery record.

findings.title: Provisioned CPU exceeds observed demand
findings.observation: One of eight cores is used in the point-in-time benchmark snapshot.
findings.impact: The current profile may carry avoidable compute cost.
findings.action: Compare a 30-day percentile profile before selecting a smaller SKU.
findings.validation: Load-test the proposed SKU and confirm latency and saturation SLOs.

findings.title: Ownership tags are incomplete
findings.observation: Required owner, environment, cost_center, or lifecycle tags are absent.
findings.impact: Cost attribution and operational ownership require manual reconciliation.
evidence: resources missing one or more required tags = 37
findings.action: Apply the required tag policy and assign an exception owner.
findings.validation: Re-run policy evaluation and verify zero unowned exceptions.

limitations: Savings are benchmark estimates and are not billing commitments.
Operator approval is required before remediation.
